content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Cloud payroll, tax filing and HR software sold to small and mid-sized employers, overlapping Intuit's small business payroll line."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Payroll processing, tax filing and cloud payroll software for employers of all sizes, matching Intuit's payroll business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Software for nonprofits, schools and healthcare donors, a different customer base and business from Intuit."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for telecom and pay-TV operators, unrelated to Intuit's products and customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer engagement and knowledge software for large service operations, not tax, accounting or small business finance."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Cloud business management and payments software for small service businesses, overlapping Intuit's small business software and payments."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Consumer cybersecurity and identity protection is the core business; personal finance is only a minor add-on to Intuit's tax and accounting products."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Deposit capture and identity verification sold to banks and fintechs, not to small businesses or individual taxpayers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Publishes news, books and property portals, earning from readers and advertisers rather than selling financial software."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Cloud payroll and HR software with payroll tax filing for mid-sized US employers, matching Intuit's payroll business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Application development and data infrastructure software for enterprise IT teams, unrelated to Intuit's financial products."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, video and contact center software, a communications business with no overlap with Intuit's financial software."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Portfolio, fund administration and back-office software for asset managers and banks, not Intuit's small business or consumer finance products."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Credit reporting, risk data and background screening sold to lenders and employers, a data business rather than Intuit's software."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise work management and content software sold to large organizations, with no tax, accounting or payroll overlap."}]}
